    rules_terminal = collections.defaultdict(set)
    rules_binary = collections.defaultdict(set)

        parts = line.split(' -> ')
        lhs = parts[0].strip()
        rhs = parts[1].strip()

        rhs_parts = rhs.split(' ')
        if len(rhs_parts) == 1:
            term = rhs_parts[0].strip("'")
            rules_terminal[term].add(lhs)
        elif len(rhs_parts) == 2:
            rules_binary[(rhs_parts[0], rhs_parts[1])].add(lhs)

    for i in range(n):

    return 'S' in dp[n][0]
